label: b54: r2d2nguvals (R2D2 paper cell at NGU's Adam eps, target period, IS 0, eta 1.0, alpha 8), seed 2 of 8, 700k steps = 22.4M moves, 70k updates
notes: Batch b54, the attribution wave for b53 (docs/runs.md b53, docs/findings.md): b53's beta = 0 control (ngubeta0) reads 92-96% of stage-A rows >=98% over 400k-700k steps where b52's R2D2 paper cell reads 0-5% (and first reaches 98% at 528k-880k against 93k-207k), at one replay ratio and one update count a step. Four things moved together between the two: (V) the values -- Adam eps 1e-3 -> 1e-4, target copy 2,500 -> 1,500, IS exponent 0.6 -> 0, priority eta 0.9 -> 1.0, ladder alpha 7 -> 8; (R) the estimator -- 5-step double-Q -> transformed Retrace lambda 0.95, with NGU's prefill (6,250 windows) and its permuted ladder; (M) the mixture family -- 32 lanes on 32 discounts 0.997 .. 0.99 with the index one-hot into the LSTM. Two cells of 4 seeds walk the chain b52a-d -> r2d2nguvals (+V) -> ngu1mix (+R) -> b53e-h (+M): r2d2nguvals (a-d) is b52's r2d2 spec verbatim with the five values at NGU's, knobs only; ngu1mix (e-h) is b53's ngubeta0 spec verbatim at SNEK_NGU_MIXTURES=1 SNEK_NGU_ASSIGN=episode (fixed needs lanes = mixtures; a uniform draw over one mixture is mixture 0), so every lane acts and learns at beta 0, gamma 0.997 and the one-hot is a constant. NOT separated: Retrace from the prefill and the permutation inside R; the previous-intrinsic-reward input (0 at beta 0) rides with R. CAP 700k counted steps = 22.4M moves, 70,000 updates (the user, 2026-11-25: the steps past 700k added little -- ngubeta0's stage-A >=98% rate is 92-96% over 400k-700k and 90-92% over 700k-1.3M, and the record row is @617000). Nothing in either algorithm reads the cap, so b52a-d and b53e-h rows <= 700k are the references as they stand. READ AT 700k b52a-d HAS BARELY ARRIVED, so the wave attributes the ONSET and the 400k-700k density; a cell that looks like b52 at 700k is 'not arrived by 700k', not 'no gain at 1.3M'. Projection from b52's and b53's desktop waves scaled by 700/1300: ~15 h for the r2d2nguvals wave, ~28 h for the ngu1mix wave. Both cells smoked on the laptop 2026-11-25 (2,000 steps). Registered prediction (the agent, 2026-11-25): r2d2nguvals arrives earlier than b52a-d but stays well short of ngubeta0 (under 40% of 400k-700k rows >=98%); ngu1mix is level with ngubeta0 within noise -- Retrace carries most of the gain and the discount family little. Stage A every 1,000 counted steps, 700 evals an arm.
